records.source: THE HOOK IS ``done`` AND NOT ``reject``, and not ``closeEvent`` alone. Escape reaches ``reject``, which hides the window WITHOUT a close event, and that would leave a measure run -- minutes of work, on a thread -- going behind a window nobody can see; a running ``QThread`` destroyed at exit aborts the process. Overriding ``reject`` to close instead looks like the fix and is a loop: ``QDialog.closeEvent`` itself calls ``reject``.

Escape reaches ``reject``, which hides the window WITHOUT a close event, and that would leave a measure run -- minutes of work, on an independent execution path -- going behind a window nobody can see; an executing ``QThread`` destroyed at exit aborts the process. Overriding ``reject`` to close instead looks like the fix and is a loop: ``QDialog.closeEvent`` itself calls ``reject``.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.picture_export#2
records.source: A picture on screen is often the thing somebody wants in a slide an hour later, and the route to it was a screenshot of a window, at the window's resolution, with the surrounding chrome in it. This saves THE PICTURE, at the resolution it was rendered at rather than the size it happens to be shown at, into a file of the user's choosing.
records.context: A picture on application view is often the thing somebody wants in a slide an hour later, and the route to it was a screenshot of a window, at the window's resolution, with the surrounding chrome in it. This saves the picture, at the resolution it was rendered at rather than the size it happens to be shown at, into a file of the user's choosing.
records.translation: En bild på skärmen är ofta det som någon vill ha i en presentation en timme senare, och vägen dit var en skärmdump av ett fönster, i fönstrets upplösning, med den omgivande ramen med. Detta sparar SJÄLVA BILDEN, i den upplösning den återgavs i snarare än den storlek den råkar visas i, till en fil som användaren väljer.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.picture_export#3
records.source: TWO FORMATS, AND THE PDF IS NOT A PNG WITH A DIFFERENT EXTENSION. A raster dropped into a PDF satisfies the file name and nothing else; a figure panel is a page, and a page has a size in millimetres. :func:`save_picture` gives the PDF a page the image's own shape and tells the writer the resolution Preferences carries, so the picture lands at the size it was measured at and prints at that resolution.
records.context: Two formats, and the PDF is not a PNG with a different extension. A raster dropped into a PDF satisfies the file name and nothing else; a figure panel is a page, and a page has a size in millimetres. :func:`save_picture` gives the PDF a page the image's own shape and tells the writer the resolution Preferences carries, so the picture lands at the size it was measured at and prints at that resolution.
records.translation: TVÅ FORMAT, OCH PDF-FILEN ÄR INTE EN PNG MED EN ANNAN FILÄNDELSE. En rasterbild som släppts in i en PDF uppfyller filnamnet och inget annat; en figurpanel är en sida, och en sida har en storlek i millimeter. :func:`save_picture` ger PDF-filen en sida med bildens egen form och talar om för skrivaren den upplösning som Inställningar anger, så att bilden hamnar i den storlek den mättes i och skrivs ut i den upplösningen.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)
